description: Defines the Base64Attachment class for handling file attachments encoded in Base64, including methods for creating instances from uploaded files or arrays, and retrieving decoded content.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A data transfer object for handling Base64-encoded file attachments, with properties for filename, file type, size, and content, and methods for creating instances and accessing decoded content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with filename, file type, Base64 content, and size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Decodes and returns the original content from Base64.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Encodes and sets the content in Base64.

methods.name: createFromUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an instance from an UploadedFile object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance from an array with attachment data.
